1479-2907-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Scute Swarm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3129-7282-8160.easyPrerequisites:
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
3129-7282-8160.description:
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4.
3129-7282-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

1174-1671-3869-4893.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least one mana.
1174-1671-3869-4893.description:
Activate another land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and returning the land tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by paying {G}{U} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card and put the land returned to hand in step 2 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

728-883-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-864-2438-3125-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2438-3125-6351.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

907-5686-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

4050-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4050-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Repeat.

2073-2099-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-2099-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

129-1409-1753-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6150-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6150-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6150-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-6150-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6150-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3372-4050-5434-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-5434-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

4186-4506-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4506-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1394-2060-5256-7038-7061.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Solid Ground.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Solid Ground.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-6695-6871-6879.description:
Cast Eye of Ramos by paying its mana cost.
When Eye of Ramos enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Eye of Ramos.
Activate Eye of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Eye of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-6705-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2438-5170-5933-6132.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3490-5295-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5295-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1796-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

4067-6969.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five experience counters.
4067-6969.description:
Activate Atreus by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to draw a card for each experience counter you have, discard a card, and deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2 until you have {3} or more available.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Atreus.
Repeat.
4067-6969.notes: If the permanent taps for {2} or more, the number of experience counters you need can be reduced. The minimum number of counters would be three.

339-677-2438-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

24-918-1640.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Donna Noble instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-918-1640.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

2173-3239-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

3525-5268-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

660-2018-4053.description:
Activate Treva's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
When Treva's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Treva's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-5876.description:
Activate Elenda's Hierophant by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Elenda's Hierophant triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1414-2051-4970-5751-6556.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in your hand.
1414-2051-4970-5751-6556.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2187-4002-4067-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
2187-4002-4067-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Possessed Skaab.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Possessed Skaab that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

372-3277-3306.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
372-3277-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

282-1379-1558-3866.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
282-1379-1558-3866.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Abhorrent Overlord with haste.
When the Abhorrent Overlord token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Harpy creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Abhorrent Overlord token and the Harpy tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3426-4050-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Deranged Hermit to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Deranged Hermit and the four Squirrel tokens, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.

97-2034-2308-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
97-2034-2308-4365.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create two 4/4 Fungus Beast creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1950-4702-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Nurturing Presence attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1950-4702-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate the nontoken Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Devoted Druid tokens, you may tap them to get infinite {G}.

224-1772-3478-4826.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1636-3126.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional Rats.
1636-3126.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat, creating at least two 1/1 Rat tokens.
Intruder Alarm triggers once for each creature token created, untapping all creatures that many times.
Repeat.

233-714-2377.description:
With Urborg on the battlefield, all lands are swamps.
With Kormus Bell on the battlefield, all Swamps are 1/1 creatures.
Cast Make Obsolete, giving all creatures your opponent control -1/-1 until end of turn, destroying all their lands.
